assessments.reasoning: Section 6.5.7 names access through an invalid memory reference or invalid swizzle view as out-of-bounds and classifies executing that access as a dynamic error.

challenge.method: Compare an actually executed invalid access with an expression never evaluated, and compare the explicit alternative trap and invalid-load outcomes with the error-detection rule.
challenge.results: The proposition is conditional on execution. The source permits multiple outcomes and classifies dynamic errors even when they may be undetectable. It supplies neither a mandatory trap nor a fixed load result.

limitations: The claim applies only to a qualifying executed access under the dated draft. It does not generalize to statically rejected expressions or all input values.
